description: Defines a custom exception class 'NamespacedEntityIdInvalidException' used for handling invalid namespaced entity IDs within the Eclipse Ditto project. Includes builder pattern, JSON serialization/deserialization, and metadata.

classes.name: NamespacedEntityIdInvalidException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating invalid namespaced entity IDs, with builder pattern and JSON serialization support.

classes.name: NamespacedEntityIdInvalidException.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions related to the exception, specifically 'entityId'.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for the exception with a specified entity ID.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with the exception, if available.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a copy of the exception with new headers.
